value.rationale: A structural relaxation channel of multiplicity at least n−1 in an exponentially large constrained configuration space has a rate independent of the larger shore. It supplies a parameter-exact gap upper bound, strict density/shore monotonicity and a facilitation-number-dependent high-vacancy exponent contrasting with the previously known star case. The fact is useful even without resolving the rest of the relaxation spectrum; no unsupported transport claim is made.
